data.gender_notes: Khant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Khan' meaning 'God' and 'Da' meaning 'grace'. In Hindu mythology, 'Khant' is considered a name of God, symbolizing divine grace and protection. The name Khant carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Khant usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Khant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khant total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
